source_refs.note: Topic 5.5.1.3 Histograms (PDF 147, printed 144). Figure 5.6's chart title prints 'Maltis Test Results' (sic); the original diagram uses the chapter's ten scores.

blocks.text: Histograms show the distribution of a data set by grouping values into bins, or intervals, and showing how often values fall in each, for example how students' maths exam scores are spread.

blocks.prompt: Put the ten scores 50, 65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95, 60, 70, 88 into bins 50s, 60s, 70s, 80s and 90s.

items: Histogram: how often values fall in each bin; shows the shape of a distribution.
